supporting_schedules.title: Fixed and variable cost judgments
rows: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) is variable (41.1% of revenue in Base). It covers payment processing fees, merchant and driver transaction costs, and cloud hosting that rise and fall directly with orders.
Sales & Marketing and Product Development are semi variable. Customer promos move with competition and order volume, while engineering salaries are set by management budget.

General & Administrative (office salaries, rent, legal), Operational Support, Depreciation, and Debt Interest are mostly fixed. In 2025, total operating expenses grew only 2.2% (Rp 10,722 bn to Rp 10,954 bn) while revenue grew 15.3%. When fixed operating expenses are held constant at Rp 10,954 bn instead of scaled with revenue, GoTo reaches positive EBIT of Rp 1,066 bn in 2026F.

GoTo's revenue growth is concentrated in two segments rather than spread evenly across all segments. In 2025, Financial Technology (GoPay payments and consumer loans) grew 74.1% and contributed 91.0% of total revenue growth, while On Demand Services (Gojek rides and delivery) grew 13.8% and contributed 61.8% of total growth.

supporting_schedules.title: Fixed and variable cost judgments
rows: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) is variable (41.1% of revenue in Base). It covers payment processing fees, merchant and driver transaction costs, and cloud hosting that rise and fall directly with orders.
Sales & Marketing and Product Development are semi variable. Customer promos move with competition and order volume, while engineering salaries are set by management budget.

General & Administrative (office salaries, rent, legal), Operational Support, Depreciation, and Debt Interest are mostly fixed. In 2025, total operating expenses grew only 2.2% (Rp 10,722 bn to Rp 10,954 bn) while revenue grew 15.3%. When fixed operating expenses are held constant at Rp 10,954 bn instead of scaled with revenue, GoTo reaches positive EBIT of Rp 1,066 bn in 2026F.

GoTo's revenue growth is concentrated in two segments rather than spread evenly across all segments. In 2025, Financial Technology (GoPay payments and consumer loans) grew 74.1% and contributed 91.0% of total revenue growth, while On Demand Services (Gojek rides and delivery) grew 13.8% and contributed 61.8% of total growth.
